description: This is a PHP unit test class for the Nationality API endpoint in the OrangeHRM system. It contains test cases for CRUD operations (get all, get one, create, update, delete) on nationality data, using a specific test data fixture YAML and mock services.

classes.name: NationalityAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Nationality API endpoints in the OrangeHRM system, including tests for fetching all, fetching one, creating, updating, and deleting nationalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, truncating the Nationality table.

methods.description: Tests retrieving all nationality entries via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getOne API endpoint.

methods.name: testCreate

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate

methods.description: Tests updating an existing nationality via the API.

methods.description: Provides test cases for the update API endpoint.
